en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a devotional interior scene: a sculptural relief of Christ at the cross with the inscription 'I.N.R.I.' above on a wooden cross. Christ, wearing a crown of thorns and loincloth, leans down from the cross towards a robed figure below, whose draped garments fall in deep folds. The sculpture is mounted on a plain wall; on either side are wall‑mounted candleholders with tall candles and small floral decorations. There is a wide blank margin at the bottom typical of vintage photographic postcards.
